_about: Tree canopy per neighbourhood (engine/fetch_canopy.py in fetch-canopy.yml, then engine/canopy.py in run.sh), from ESA WorldCover 2021 (10 m, CC BY 4.0): tree cells over land cells, water left out. Its citywide 30.5% sits inside the City's 2018 Tree Canopy Study range (28-31%), so the open satellite map is used for both cities alike. 'cuts' split the lens into four bands.
